final_rationale: The verdict does not change. No new admissible evidence was provided; the Actor mainly narrowed and clarified the claim using the same record. That clarification is legitimate but not sufficient to move the result to compliant_with_caveats, because this case still lacks the required support link already identified in the initial report: admissible evidence of either final disclosure of the material limitation in launch materials or an approved mitigation/risk acceptance that satisfies the policy requirements. The distinction matters here: a caveated position can be conceptually narrower than a clean certification claim, but it is only compliant_with_caveats when the caveat itself is operationalized in evidence. On the present record, the Actor's reframing shows that caveat-free certification is unsupported, but it does not prove that the required caveated disclosure or approval actually exists. That leaves a plausible governance rationale, but an unresolved compliance predicate, so suspicious remains the proportional finding.
